code_content:
# 均值回归波段策略 - 适合震荡/弱势市场抄底
# 逻辑：RSI超卖 + 布林带下轨 + 缩量企稳 → 买入
#       反弹至中轨/RSI恢复 → 卖出
# 止损：-5% 硬止损
my_indicator_name = "均值回归波段 v1.0"

# 计算指标
df["rsi"] = df["close"].apply(lambda x: pd.Series(df["close"]).rolling(14).apply(lambda y: 100 - (100 / (1 + (y.diff().clip(lower=0).mean() / y.diff().clip(upper=0).abs().mean()))) if len(y.dropna()) >= 14 else None).iloc[-1])

# 简化RSI计算
delta = df["close"].diff()
gain = delta.clip(lower=0)
loss = -delta.clip(upper=0)
avg_gain = gain.rolling(14).mean()
avg_loss = loss.rolling(14).mean()
rs = avg_gain / avg_loss
df["rsi14"] = 100 - (100 / (1 + rs))

# 布林带
df["ma20"] = df["close"].rolling(20).mean()
df["std20"] = df["close"].rolling(20).std()
df["boll_lower"] = df["ma20"] - 2 * df["std20"]
df["boll_mid"] = df["ma20"]

# 成交量缩量
df["vol_ma10"] = df["volume"].rolling(10).mean()
df["vol_shrink"] = df["volume"] < df["vol_ma10"] * 0.8

# 买入条件：RSI < 35 + 价格接近布林下轨 + 缩量 + 不创新低
near_lower = df["close"] <= df["boll_lower"] * 1.02
not_new_low = df["low"] >= df["low"].shift(1) * 0.98

df["buy"] = (df["rsi14"] < 35) & near_lower & df["vol_shrink"] & not_new_low

# 卖出条件：RSI > 55 或 价格回到布林中轨
df["sell"] = (df["rsi14"] > 55) | (df["close"] >= df["boll_mid"] * 0.98)

my_indicator_name = '半导体均值回归 v1.0'

def calc_indicator(ctx):
    df = ctx.kline_df.copy()
    
    # === 使用因子库中的 rsi14, bollinger_lower, bollinger_upper, volume_ratio, atr14, reversal_1d ===
    
    # 【买入条件】两两组合触发（不是三重且）:
    # 条件A: RSI超卖（<38，半导体波动大放宽）
    # 条件B: 价格靠近布林下轨（<= 下轨*1.05）
    # 条件C: 放量确认（量比>0.8，不要求>1.0）
    
    rsi_ok = df['rsi14'] < 38
    bb_ok = df['close'] <= df['bollinger_lower'] * 1.05
    vol_ok = df['volume_ratio'] > 0.8
    
    # A+B 或 A+C 即可买入（不需要三门全中）
    df['buy'] = (rsi_ok & bb_ok) | (rsi_ok & vol_ok)
    
    # 【卖出条件】
    # 1. RSI反弹到58以上（不贪，半导体反弹易夭折）
    # 2. 价格触及布林上轨（完成一个完整波段）
    # 3. 单日跌超4%（硬止损）
    
    df['sell'] = (
        (df['rsi14'] > 58) |
        (df['close'] >= df['bollinger_upper'] * 0.98) |
        (df['reversal_1d'] < -0.04)
    )
    
    return df

# 核心：ADX判断市场状态，自动切换子策略
# @param adx_period int 14 ADX周期
# @param adx_threshold int 22 ADX阈值(>22=趋势,<=22=震荡)
# @param bb_period int 20 布林带周期

tr3 = abs(df["low"] - df["close"].shift(1))

atr = tr.rolling(adx_p).mean()

down_move = df["low"].shift(1) - df["low"]

minus_dm = down_move.where((down_move > up_move) & (down_move > 0), 0.0)

# GridPro-v2: Minimal Bollinger Grid with Dual Protection
#
# 🎯 核心理念：网格不是靠聪明，是靠频繁。
#    布林下轨区域买，上轨区域卖。两把刀保命。
#
# 🔪 双刀保护（v1 保留，其余全砍）：
#   1. 网格跌破止损 — 跌破BB下沿3%立即止损
#   2. 移动止盈 — 盈利>3%后启动，回撤2%止盈
#
# 🗑️ v1 被砍掉的：
#   - ADX趋势过滤 → 趋势市网格也能捡到反弹
#   - RSI确认 → 不需要，BB位置本身就是超卖/超买
#   - 缩量确认 → 不需要，缩量≠反弹
#
# 📐 网格触发区：BB下沿到(grid_low + trigger_zone*range)
#    卖触发区：BB上沿到(grid_high - trigger_zone*range)
#
# @param grid_count int 8 网格层数(3-20)
# @param bb_period int 20 布林带周期
# @param bb_std float 2.0 布林带标准差倍数
# @param trigger_zone float 0.30 网格触发区比例(买入=下沿附近，卖出=上沿附近)
# @param trail_pct float 0.02 移动止盈回撤比例
# @param min_bb_width float 0.03 最小布林带宽(低于此值不交易)
# @strategy stopLossPct 0.05
# @strategy takeProfitPct 0.15
# @strategy bear_filter_enabled false
# @strategy entryPct 0.25

# === 参数 ===
grid_count = params.get("grid_count", 8)
bb_period = params.get("bb_period", 20)
bb_std = params.get("bb_std", 2.0)
trigger_zone = params.get("trigger_zone", 0.30)
trail_pct = params.get("trail_pct", 0.02)
min_bb_width = params.get("min_bb_width", 0.03)

# === 1. 布林带 — 网格边界 ===
df["bb_mid"] = df["close"].rolling(bb_period).mean()
bb_std_val = df["close"].rolling(bb_period).std()
df["bb_lower"] = df["bb_mid"] - bb_std * bb_std_val
df["bb_upper"] = df["bb_mid"] + bb_std * bb_std_val
df["bb_width"] = (df["bb_upper"] - df["bb_lower"]) / df["bb_mid"].replace(0, float('nan'))

# BB太窄 = 横盘死水，不交易
df["grid_active"] = df["bb_width"].fillna(0) > min_bb_width

# === 2. 网格定位 ===
range_width = df["bb_upper"] - df["bb_lower"]
df["pos_in_range"] = ((df["close"] - df["bb_lower"]) / range_width.replace(0, float('nan'))).fillna(0.5)
df["pos_in_range"] = df["pos_in_range"].clip(0, 1)

df["grid_level"] = (df["pos_in_range"] * grid_count).fillna(0).astype(int).clip(0, grid_count - 1)

grid_low = df["grid_level"] / grid_count
grid_high = (df["grid_level"] + 1) / grid_count
cell_width = grid_high - grid_low
df["pos_in_grid"] = ((df["pos_in_range"] - grid_low) / cell_width.replace(0, float('nan'))).fillna(0.5)
df["pos_in_grid"] = df["pos_in_grid"].clip(0, 1)

# === 3. 买入信号 — 只在网格下沿附近 ===
at_grid_low = df["pos_in_grid"] <= trigger_zone
df["buy"] = df["grid_active"] & at_grid_low

# === 4. 卖出信号 ===
# 4a. 网格上沿卖出
at_grid_high = df["pos_in_grid"] >= (1 - trigger_zone)
grid_sell = df["grid_active"] & at_grid_high

# 4b. 🔪 刀1: 网格跌破止损
grid_breakdown = df["close"] < df["bb_lower"].fillna(0) * 0.97

# 4c. 🔪 刀2: 移动止盈
df["trade_id"] = df["buy"].cumsum()
active_trade = df["trade_id"] > 0
df["trade_peak"] = df.groupby("trade_id")["close"].cummax()
df["entry_price"] = df.groupby("trade_id")["close"].transform("first")
df["trade_pnl"] = df["close"] / df["entry_price"].replace(0, float('nan')) - 1

trail_active = df["trade_pnl"].fillna(0) > 0.03
trailing_stop_hit = trail_active & (df["close"] < df["trade_peak"] * (1 - trail_pct))

df["sell"] = active_trade & (grid_sell | grid_breakdown | trailing_stop_hit)

# v13: 趋势突破策略 — 软MA过滤 + 阳线确认 + 分级止盈
# 相比v12：
#   1. MA趋势确认从硬条件改为加分项（权重降低）

#   3. 新增分级止盈：盈利>10%出一半，盈利>20%出完
#   4. RSI宽松（50→45，进一步降低门槛）
#   5. 止损5%保持
# @param breakout_period int 15 突破周期
# @param volume_ratio float 1.5 放量倍数
# @param cooldown_days int 3 冷却天数
# @strategy stopLossPct 0.05
# @strategy takeProfitPct 0.30
# @strategy cooldownBars 3
# @strategy bear_filter_enabled true
# @strategy entryPct 0.6

bp = params.get("breakout_period", 15)
vr = params.get("volume_ratio", 1.5)
cd = params.get("cooldown_days", 3)

# === 趋势突破信号 ===
df["high_n"] = df["high"].rolling(bp).max().shift(1)
df["close_prev"] = df["close"].shift(1)
df["breakout"] = (df["close"] > df["high_n"]) & (df["close_prev"] <= df["high_n"])

# === 阳线确认（v13新增）===
df["green_day"] = df["close"] > df["open"]

# === 量能确认 ===
df["vol_ma20"] = df["volume"].rolling(20).mean()
df["vol_ok"] = df["volume"] > df["vol_ma20"] * vr

# === RSI 动量（阈值50→45）===
delta = df["close"].diff()
gain = delta.clip(lower=0).rolling(14).mean()
loss = (-delta.clip(upper=0)).rolling(14).mean()
df["rsi"] = 100 - (100 / (1 + gain / (loss + 0.0001)))
df["rsi_ok"] = df["rsi"] > 45

# === 趋势确认 ===
df["ma20"] = df["close"].rolling(20).mean()
df["ma10"] = df["close"].rolling(10).mean()
df["trend_ok"] = df["close"] > df["ma20"]

# === v13：软MA趋势过滤 ===
# MA10必须在MA20上方（硬条件），但MA10斜率只做加分
# 如果MA10斜率向上 → 直接买入
# 如果MA10斜率平或向下 → 需要近3日都收阳（趋势逆转确认）
df["ma10_slope_ok"] = df["ma10"] > df["ma10"].shift(5)
df["3d_green"] = (df["close"] > df["open"]) & (df["close"].shift(1) > df["open"].shift(1)) & (df["close"].shift(2) > df["open"].shift(2))
df["ma_trend_ok"] = df["ma10"] > df["ma20"]  # 只要求MA10>MA20（硬条件）
df["momentum_ok"] = df["ma10_slope_ok"] | df["3d_green"]  # 斜率向上OR三连阳

# === 主力资金过滤 ===
mf = df.get("main_net_inflow")
if mf is not None:
    has_data = mf.notna()
    df["main_ok"] = ~has_data | (mf.fillna(0) > 0)
    mf3 = mf.fillna(0).rolling(3).sum()
    df["main_trend_ok"] = ~has_data | (mf3 > 0)
else:
    df["main_ok"] = True

# 相比v3的改进：
#   1. breakout_period: 10→5 (更快捕捉突破)
#   2. vol_factor: 1.2→1.0 (量≥均量即可，无需放量20%)
#   3. rsi_low: 40→35, rsi_max: 70→78 (放宽RSI区间)
#   4. rsi_exit: 78→82 (多留一点上涨空间)
#   5. 🔴 取消prev_green要求(突破只需当前K阳线，不需连阳确认)
# @param breakout_period int 5 突破周期(K线根数)
# @param vol_factor float 1.0 放量倍数(1.0=均量即可)
# @param rsi_low int 35 RSI下限
# @param rsi_max int 78 RSI买入上限

# @param vol_climax float 3.0 派发量倍数
# @param trailing_pct float 0.03 移动止盈回撤%
# @param trailing_tight float 0.02 收紧后移动止盈回撤%
# @param trail_trigger float 0.05 收紧触发阈值
# @strategy stopLossPct 0.04
# @strategy takeProfitPct 0.12
# @strategy bear_filter_enabled false
# @strategy entryPct 0.5

n = params.get("breakout_period", 5)
vol_factor = params.get("vol_factor", 1.0)
rsil = params.get("rsi_low", 35)
rsim = params.get("rsi_max", 78)
rsih = params.get("rsi_exit", 82)
vol_climax_signal = params.get("vol_climax", 3.0)
tr = params.get("trailing_pct", 0.03)
tr_tight = params.get("trailing_tight", 0.02)
tr_trigger = params.get("trail_trigger", 0.05)

# === 基础指标 ===

df["high_n_prev"] = df["high_n"].shift(1)
df["vol_ma30"] = df["volume"].rolling(30).mean()
df["ma20"] = df["close"].rolling(20).mean()
df["ema12"] = df["close"].ewm(span=12, adjust=False).mean()

# RSI(14)

gain = delta.clip(lower=0).rolling(14).mean()
loss = (-delta.clip(upper=0)).rolling(14).mean()
df["rsi"] = 100 - (100 / (1 + gain / (loss + 0.0001)))

# === K线 ===
df["green_bar"] = df["close"] > df["open"]
df["bearish_bar"] = df["close"] < df["open"]

# === 突破信号(v4: 取消prev_green, 只要求当前阳线) ===
breakout_price = df["close"] > df["high_n_prev"]
df["breakout"] = breakout_price & df["green_bar"]

# === 量能(v4: 均量即可) ===
df["vol_ok"] = df["volume"] > df["vol_ma30"] * vol_factor

# === RSI(v4: 放宽到35-78) ===
df["rsi_ok"] = (df["rsi"] > rsil) & (df["rsi"] < rsim)

# === 趋势确认 ===

# === 时间窗口 ===
try:
    h = df.index.hour.astype(int)
    m = df.index.minute.astype(int)
    morning = (h == 9) | ((h == 10) & (m <= 30))
    early_noon = (h == 13) & (m <= 30)
    afternoon = (h >= 14)
    time_ok = morning | early_noon | afternoon
except:

# === 买入信号 ===
df["buy"] = df["breakout"] & df["vol_ok"] & df["rsi_ok"] & df["trend_ok"] & time_ok

# === 卖出信号 ===
df["trade_id"] = df["buy"].cumsum()
active = df["trade_id"] > 0
grouper = df.groupby("trade_id")

df["trade_peak"] = grouper["close"].cummax()
df["entry_price"] = grouper["close"].transform("first")
df["trade_pnl"] = df["close"] / df["entry_price"] - 1

in_tight_mode = df["trade_pnl"] > tr_trigger
trail_stop_normal = df["close"] < df["trade_peak"] * (1 - tr)
trail_stop_tight = df["close"] < df["trade_peak"] * (1 - tr_tight)
trailing_exit = trail_stop_normal & ~in_tight_mode | trail_stop_tight & in_tight_mode

climax_exit = (df["volume"] > df["vol_ma30"] * vol_climax_signal) & df["bearish_bar"]
ema_exit = df["close"] < df["ema12"] * 0.97

try:
    late_time = (h == 14) & (m >= 45)

low_profit = (df["trade_pnl"] < 0.02) & (df["trade_pnl"] < tr_trigger)
late_exit = late_time & low_profit

description: 自适应网格策略：ADX震荡市识别 + BB动态网格 + RSI+缩量确认 + 跌破止损 + 移动止盈。6项改进对标基础GridTradingStrategy。
code_content:
# GridPro-v1: Adaptive Range Grid with Regime Filter
# 
# 🎯 核心理念：震荡市（ADX<22）中，布林带为自适应网格边界，
#    网格下沿缩量超卖买入，上沿放量超买卖出。趋势市自动暂停。
#
# 🔧 相比基础 GridTradingStrategy 的 6 项改进：
#   1. ADX趋势过滤 — 趋势市暂停网格，避免逆势加仓被套
#   2. BB动态网格 — 布林带自适应范围，替代固定ATR范围
#   3. RSI确认 — 下沿买入需RSI<45（超卖区有反弹动力）
#   4. 缩量确认 — 买入时要求成交量收缩（卖压枯竭信号）
#   5. 网格跌破止损 — 跌破BB下沿3%立即止损
#   6. 移动止盈 — 盈利>3%后启动，回撤2%止盈（防利润坐过山车）
#
# @param grid_count int 8 网格层数(3-20)
# @param bb_period int 20 布林带周期
# @param bb_std float 2.0 布林带标准差倍数
# @param adx_period int 14 ADX计算周期
# @param adx_max int 22 ADX上限(>此值视为趋势市，暂停网格)
# @param rsi_period int 14 RSI周期
# @param rsi_buy_max int 45 RSI买入上限
# @param rsi_sell_min int 55 RSI卖出下限
# @param vol_dry float 0.85 缩量系数(相对20日均量)
# @param trigger_zone float 0.25 网格触发区比例
# @param trail_pct float 0.02 移动止盈回撤比例
# @param min_bb_width float 0.04 最小布林带宽(低于此值网格无效)
# @strategy stopLossPct 0.05
# @strategy takeProfitPct 0.15
# @strategy bear_filter_enabled false
# @strategy entryPct 0.5

# === 参数 ===
grid_count = params.get("grid_count", 8)
bb_period = params.get("bb_period", 20)
bb_std = params.get("bb_std", 2.0)
adx_period = params.get("adx_period", 14)
adx_max = params.get("adx_max", 22)
rsi_period = params.get("rsi_period", 14)
rsi_buy_max = params.get("rsi_buy_max", 45)
rsi_sell_min = params.get("rsi_sell_min", 55)
vol_dry = params.get("vol_dry", 0.85)
trigger_zone = params.get("trigger_zone", 0.25)
trail_pct = params.get("trail_pct", 0.02)
min_bb_width = params.get("min_bb_width", 0.04)

# === 1. 布林带 — 自适应网格边界 ===
df["bb_mid"] = df["close"].rolling(bb_period).mean()
bb_std_val = df["close"].rolling(bb_period).std()
df["bb_lower"] = df["bb_mid"] - bb_std * bb_std_val
df["bb_upper"] = df["bb_mid"] + bb_std * bb_std_val
df["bb_width"] = (df["bb_upper"] - df["bb_lower"]) / df["bb_mid"].replace(0, float('nan'))

# === 2. ADX — 市场状态判断 ===
tr1 = df["high"] - df["low"]
tr2 = (df["high"] - df["close"].shift(1)).abs()
tr3 = (df["low"] - df["close"].shift(1)).abs()
tr = pd.concat([tr1, tr2, tr3], axis=1).max(axis=1)
atr_val = tr.rolling(adx_period).mean()

up_move = df["high"] - df["high"].shift(1)
down_move = df["low"].shift(1) - df["low"]
plus_dm = up_move.where((up_move > down_move) & (up_move > 0), 0.0)
minus_dm = down_move.where((down_move > up_move) & (down_move > 0), 0.0)

plus_di = 100 * (plus_dm.rolling(adx_period).mean() / atr_val.replace(0, float('nan')))
minus_di = 100 * (minus_dm.rolling(adx_period).mean() / atr_val.replace(0, float('nan')))
dx = 100 * (plus_di - minus_di).abs() / (plus_di + minus_di + 0.0001)
df["adx"] = dx.rolling(adx_period).mean()

df["is_ranging"] = df["adx"].fillna(100) <= adx_max
df["grid_active"] = df["is_ranging"] & (df["bb_width"].fillna(0) > min_bb_width)

# === 3. RSI ===
delta = df["close"].diff()
gain = delta.clip(lower=0).rolling(rsi_period).mean()
loss = (-delta.clip(upper=0)).rolling(rsi_period).mean()
df["rsi"] = 100 - (100 / (1 + gain / (loss + 0.0001)))

# === 4. 成交量 ===
df["vol_ma20"] = df["volume"].rolling(20).mean()

# === 5. 网格定位 ===
range_width = df["bb_upper"] - df["bb_lower"]
df["pos_in_range"] = ((df["close"] - df["bb_lower"]) / range_width.replace(0, float('nan'))).fillna(0.5)
df["pos_in_range"] = df["pos_in_range"].clip(0, 1)

df["grid_level"] = (df["pos_in_range"] * grid_count).fillna(0).astype(int).clip(0, grid_count - 1)

grid_low_pos = df["grid_level"] / grid_count
grid_high_pos = (df["grid_level"] + 1) / grid_count
cell_width = grid_high_pos - grid_low_pos
df["pos_in_grid"] = ((df["pos_in_range"] - grid_low_pos) / cell_width.replace(0, float('nan'))).fillna(0.5)
df["pos_in_grid"] = df["pos_in_grid"].clip(0, 1)

# === 6. 买入信号 ===
at_grid_low = df["pos_in_grid"] <= trigger_zone
rsi_buy_ok = df["rsi"].fillna(50) < rsi_buy_max
vol_dry_ok = df["volume"] < df["vol_ma20"].fillna(df["volume"] * 2) * vol_dry

df["buy"] = df["grid_active"] & at_grid_low & rsi_buy_ok & vol_dry_ok

# === 7. 卖出信号 ===
at_grid_high = df["pos_in_grid"] >= (1 - trigger_zone)
rsi_sell_ok = df["rsi"].fillna(50) > rsi_sell_min
grid_sell = df["grid_active"] & at_grid_high & rsi_sell_ok

# 网格跌破止损
grid_breakdown = df["close"] < df["bb_lower"].fillna(0) * 0.97

# 移动止盈
df["trade_id"] = df["buy"].cumsum()
active_trade = df["trade_id"] > 0
df["trade_peak"] = df.groupby("trade_id")["close"].cummax()
df["entry_price"] = df.groupby("trade_id")["close"].transform("first")
df["trade_pnl"] = df["close"] / df["entry_price"].replace(0, float('nan')) - 1

trail_active = df["trade_pnl"].fillna(0) > 0.03
trailing_stop_hit = trail_active & (df["close"] < df["trade_peak"] * (1 - trail_pct))

df["sell"] = active_trade & (grid_sell | grid_breakdown | trailing_stop_hit)

    uptrend = c > m60           # ← 趋势过滤：只在60日线上方做多
    
    if not in_position:

        near_ma = (abs(c / m20 - 1) < 0.02 and is_bullish and vol_surge)

            in_position = False
            cooling = COOLING
            continue

                in_position = False
                cooling = COOLING
                continue
        
        # ATR追踪止盈 ← v3.3: 2×ATR替代固定3%
        if pnl > 0:
            atr_stop = 2.0 * atr_i / c      # 2倍ATR相对百分比

code_content:
"""
趋势跟踪策略 v1.0: MA金叉突破 + MACD + 量能确认

核心思路：
  - MA5上穿MA20(金叉) + MACD金叉 + 量比>1.3 → 买入
  - 宽幅ATR追踪止盈(3×ATR) → 让利润奔跑
  - 双MA死叉(MA5下穿MA20) → 确认趋势结束卖出
  - 硬止损 -8%

适用市场：趋势/单边上涨
不适用：震荡市（会反复止损）
"""

close = df["close"]
open_p = df["open"]
volume = df["volume"]
high = df["high"]

HARD_STOP = -0.08
COOLING = 2
VOL_RATIO = 1.3

n = len(df)

ma5 = close.rolling(5).mean()
ma20 = close.rolling(20).mean()
ma60 = close.rolling(60).mean()
vol_ma20 = volume.rolling(20).mean()

# MACD
ema12 = close.ewm(span=12).mean()
ema26 = close.ewm(span=26).mean()
macd_line = ema12 - ema26
macd_signal = macd_line.ewm(span=9).mean()

# ATR (simplified)
tr = pd.concat([high - close.shift(1), high - close.shift(1), close.shift(1) - close.shift(1)], axis=1).fillna(0).abs().sum(axis=1) / 3
atr = tr.rolling(14).mean()

df["buy"] = False
df["sell"] = False

in_position = False
entry_price = 0.0
swing_high = 0.0
cooling = 0
bars_held = 0

for i in range(65, n):
    c = close.iloc[i]
    o = open_p.iloc[i]
    m5 = ma5.iloc[i]
    m20 = ma20.iloc[i]
    m60 = ma60.iloc[i]
    vol = volume.iloc[i]
    vma = vol_ma20.iloc[i]
    macd_i = macd_line.iloc[i]
    macd_sig = macd_signal.iloc[i]
    atr_i = atr.iloc[i]
    
    if pd.isna(c) or pd.isna(m5) or pd.isna(vma) or pd.isna(macd_i) or pd.isna(atr_i):
        continue
    
    # 前一日
    m5_prev = ma5.iloc[i-1]
    m20_prev = ma20.iloc[i-1]
    macd_prev = macd_line.iloc[i-1]
    macd_sig_prev = macd_signal.iloc[i-1]
    
    vol_surge = vol > vma * VOL_RATIO
    macd_golden = (macd_prev < macd_sig_prev) and (macd_i > macd_sig)   # MACD金叉
    ma_golden = (m5_prev < m20_prev) and (m5 > m20)                      # MA金叉
    
    if not in_position:
        if cooling > 0:
            cooling -= 1
            continue
        
        # 买入: MA金叉 + MACD金叉 + 量能放大 + 在60日线上方
        if ma_golden and macd_golden and vol_surge and c > m60:
            df.iloc[i, df.columns.get_loc("buy")] = True
            in_position = True
            entry_price = c
            swing_high = c
            bars_held = 0
    
    else:
        bars_held += 1
        
        if c > swing_high:
            swing_high = c
        
        pnl = c / entry_price - 1
        
        # 硬止损
        if pnl <= HARD_STOP:
            df.iloc[i, df.columns.get_loc("sell")] = True
            in_position = False
            cooling = COOLING
            continue
        
        # MA死叉 → 趋势结束确认
        ma5_now = ma5.iloc[i]
        ma20_now = ma20.iloc[i]
        ma5_prev2 = ma5.iloc[i-1]
        ma20_prev2 = ma20.iloc[i-1]
        ma_dead = (ma5_prev2 > ma20_prev2) and (ma5_now < ma20_now) and bars_held > 3
        
        if ma_dead:
            df.iloc[i, df.columns.get_loc("sell")] = True
            in_position = False
            cooling = COOLING
            continue
        
        # 宽幅ATR追踪止盈 (3x ATR - 给趋势更多空间)
        if pnl > 0.03:   # 先有3%浮盈才启动追踪
            atr_stop = 3.0 * atr_i / c
            drawdown = c / swing_high - 1
            if drawdown <= -atr_stop:
                df.iloc[i, df.columns.get_loc("sell")] = True
